AXL-WP-01.now: Digital media companies keep collapsing the same way. Between 2022 and 2024 most of them went down at once.
AXL-WP-01.you: If you run, fund or advertise with a creator-driven company, this is the failure pattern to check for before it happens to you.
AXL-WP-01.us: Our principal spent seven years inside VICE and VIRTUE. This is the inside view, checked against the public record.

AXL-WP-02.now: Austin is rebuilding I-35 right now, so the work zones we need to measure are live.
AXL-WP-02.you: If you fund transportation, insure drivers or build roads, a $40,000 measurement stands between you and $1.2B–$8.3B a year in recoverable loss.
AXL-WP-02.us: We treat the merge as a behavior problem, not an information problem. Every past campaign tried to inform drivers, and every one failed for that reason.

AXL-WP-03.now: Trust in public institutions is at record lows, and messaging hasn't brought it back.
AXL-WP-03.you: If your work depends on public trust, as a newsroom, a clinic, a foundation or a brand, this is a step-by-step method for rebuilding it, with an index to measure it.
AXL-WP-03.us: It is the operating manual for how we work, published in the open, with six conditions under which we would retract it.

AXL-WP-04.now: Institutions are failing all at once, and the failures look unrelated. They share one cause.
AXL-WP-04.you: If anything you run depends on public trust, this is the diagnosis underneath the problems you are already fighting.
AXL-WP-04.us: It is the theory behind every paper we publish, built from the inside of media, advertising and political campaigns.

AXL-WP-05.now: AI is the most powerful self-esteem engine ever built, and most of it is tuned to tell people what they want to hear.
AXL-WP-05.you: If you build products, run a school or treat patients, this explains why making people feel good keeps backfiring, and what to do instead.
AXL-WP-05.us: We follow the idea from 1960s California to Silicon Valley and into the clinic, and show where each step went wrong.

AXL-WP-06.now: Hardware is running into physical limits. The cheapest gains left are psychological, and AI can deliver them at scale.
AXL-WP-06.you: If you lead a nonprofit, a newsroom, an arts group or a public agency, the psychology brands use to sell can work for your mission.
AXL-WP-06.us: We come from the brand side, and we built the method for pointing those tools at public problems.

AXL-WP-07.now: AI-written filings are flooding the courts. By late August 2026, nearly two thousand decisions had dealt with fabricated citations.
AXL-WP-07.you: If you run, fund or reform a court system, your clearance numbers can look fine while outcomes get worse. This is the measure that catches it.
AXL-WP-07.us: We build measurements that can't be gamed, and this one comes with a way to pay for itself: a small levy on AI use.

AXL-WP-08.now: AI changes how work gets done and how meaning moves between people at the same time, and half of Americans already say it worries them more than it excites them.
AXL-WP-08.you: If you build, fund or regulate AI, safety work only pays off when the public can see it and believe it. This is a plan for building that trust.
AXL-WP-08.us: We come from media, advertising and campaigns, where trust is made and lost, and we've published the predictions that would prove us wrong.

AXL-WP-09.now: AI made polished proposals free, so polish no longer tells a funder anything.
AXL-WP-09.you: If you give grants, you can finally find out whether your picks were right, using lotteries that four major funders already run.
AXL-WP-09.us: We design systems that pay people to find flaws, and we built this one so funders learn which reviews were right.

THE-NECTAR.now: People are leaving feeds that feel worse every year, and there is nowhere good to go.
THE-NECTAR.you: If you fund community, culture or public health, this is a working model you can back or copy.
THE-NECTAR.us: The first one is already running, and we wrote down exactly how it works.
